rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
rules.description: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Crossing Attack
rules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Disintegrate
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2).

rules.name: Dodge
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

rules.name: Enhanced Scrapper
rules.description: If this model has Scrapper, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Scrapper (instead of only results of 6).

rules.name: Enhanced Scrapper Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Scrapper. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Vicious
rules.description: If this model has Vicious, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Vicious (instead of only results of 6).

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Mind Control
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction. Each unit may only be moved once per round in this way.

rules.name: Precise
rules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

rules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Precision Tag
rules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, place X tokens on one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight, or one token on X enemy units within 24" and in line of sight. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to hit to get +1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Ranged Shrouding
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting, that enemy unit gets -4" range to a min. of 6".

rules.name: Ranged Shrouding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Scout
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

rules.name: Scout Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Scrapper
rules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

rules.name: Shatter
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+3).

rules.name: Shielded
rules.description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Stealth Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unique Hero
rules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

rules.name: Unpredictable
rules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
rules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Shooter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Vicious
rules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

spells.name: Feral Strike
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 1 hit with AP(2) and Deadly(3).

spells.name: Mind Shaper
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Power Field
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Shielded once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Power Maw
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 6", which take 4 hits with AP(2) each.

spells.name: Psy-Hunter
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Scrapper once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Quill Blast
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Disintegrate.
